description: This file manages drain files for application signaling, including creating, ranking, checking expiration, and cleaning up drain files in a specified directory.

methods.name: ExtractAppKey
methods.description: Extracts the application key from a drain filename based on underscores.

methods.name: ExtractTimestamp
methods.description: Extracts the timestamp from a drain filename and converts it to microseconds.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Determines if a drain file is expired based on its timestamp.

methods.name: FindAllWithPrefix
methods.description: Finds all filenames in a directory that start with a given prefix.

methods.name: Rank
methods.description: Ranks drain files in a directory by timestamp and app key, returning the highest priority app key.

methods.name: TryDrain
methods.description: Checks for existing valid drain files for an app; creates one if none exist.

methods.name: RankAndCheck
methods.description: Ranks drain files and checks if the top-ranked app matches the given app key.

methods.name: ClearExpired
methods.description: Removes expired drain files from the directory.

methods.name: ClearForApp
methods.description: Removes all drain files for a specific app.

methods.name: PrepareDirectory
methods.description: Prepares the directory by removing unrelated drain files.

methods.name: IsAppDraining
methods.description: Checks if the specified app is currently draining.

methods.name: IsAnotherAppDraining
methods.description: Checks if any other app is draining.
